rationale.conceptual: The method is an established classical MD protocol, but it requires non-trivial understanding of the dipole quenching condition (Eq. 1), correct manipulation of ion densities in the calcite surface, and the proper construction of four simulation blocks per interface. It involves several interacting components (force fields, slab termination, monolayer densities) and careful implementation to avoid errors.
rationale.execution: The pipeline requires setting up 6 interfaces × 4 blocks = 24 MD simulations in DL_POLY or LAMMPS, each needing tailored atomic configurations and force field parameter files. This involves non-trivial tool orchestration, data preparation, and a clear sequence of steps (build systems, run NVT, collect average energies, compute interfacial energies). The workflow is moderate but not extremely long.
